An '''Andalian cloak''' was a type of long, hooded [[Cloak/Legends|cloak]]<ref name="ROTSVD" /> originating in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster's]] [[Andalia system/Legends|Andalia system]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was [[Color/Legends|maroon]] and blue in color. [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Solipo Yeb]] owned an expensive Andalian cloak which<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|353|Yeb, Solipo}}</ref> he<ref name="Ask Lobot">{{InsiderCite|102|Ask Lobot}}</ref> wore to the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]] of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]<ref name="CSWE" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="ROTS date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Andalian cloaks were first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'' by [[James Luceno]],<ref name="ROTSVD" /> released on [[April 2]], [[2005]].<ref name="ROTSTVD release date">{{DK|url=us/9780756611286-star-wars-revenge-of-the-sith-the-visual-dictionary|text=Star Wars Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary|oldversion=20151018025119}}</ref> As that reference book was released prior to the final film of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> on [[May 19]] of that year,<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> it was unknown if they would have appeared in the film alongside Solipo Yeb at the time.<ref name="Ask Lobot" /> Ultimately, no character wearing the cloak can be seen in the film.<ref name="ROTS" />
